column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “one who acts prudently” is rendered “any who understand.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “as” in “as they eat bread.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they fear a fear” is rendered “they are in great dread.”
“You will put to shame” is rendered “You would put to shame,” and “for” as “But.”
“Who will give” is rendered “Oh, that,” and “turns back the captivity of His people” as “restores His captive people”; the wishes “let Jacob rejoice” are rendered as futures.
